summary: Mounted debugfs on the running Android, read regulator_summary and pm_genpd_summary (pd_hsi0 on, four USB rails enabled with one user each), then clk_summary: the read returned 255 after 0.23 s, adb vanished, the host saw SEC_UPLOAD and then Android again after about 47 s without owner action. clk_summary was not obtained and must not be repeated without a new decision; the mount was removed by the restart, not by the capture script.
evidence_category: android-userland: read-only software state of the running Android on this S24 (one reverted-by-reboot debugfs mount); not loader-entry state and not native-device evidence

findings: Reading clk_summary on this kernel is not safe on this phone: do not repeat it. A bus/register fault from a read in an unpowered clock domain is a plausible mechanism and is an inference, not a measurement.
The capture plan check passed and the timeout protected nothing: the failure took the kernel down in under a second.
